regions.full_page: Since receiving your recent note favor- for which, MANY THANKS - and your practical request in regard to the benefits of the Sera- phic Mass Assotian, I am moved to earenst thought and action on a project that for many months has been floating in my mind. Thanks be to God for His patience with me in not lifting the thought away from me - the inspiration, perhaps I ought to say -- till your ap- preciated communication awakened me to decision. The benefits of this association, as seem to me, are so mani- fest in many cases and so mnifold that to enumerate them even briefly would require more than a short letter, time for writing which is about all I have at my disposal. I shall try, however, not to disapoint you entirely by giving you a short summary of such benefits or advantages. To start with our holy Mother the Church quite singles-out this association as outstanding in importance by granting to promoters of the work three hundred days indulgence for every enrollment - nay, for every effort made, even if it be but a few words in its favor, to further the interests of the Association. (See inclosed booklet, page 13). The diversity and in some cases the magnitude of The manifold reports of favors received here as through/Associa- tion ought to convince any thinker', of the wonderful benefits acruing to its members thru this providential organization. Let me give here a single example at least, of the notes made in this office of such fav- ors as I am sure would interest the members of your esteemed organiza- tion. I think it was in August that a certain Mrs. B., anxious about her son shortly to leave for over-seas enrolled him in the "Seraphic Mass". The note follow "October 5, 1945, Mrs. Fred Brewer ... reports having enrolled her son Fred and his comrade and ship-crew, etc. The ship crossed the Atlantic Okay; but two hours before scheduled landing she struck
